label: Concrete GOD_4 is necessary if existent at the standpoint
definition: GodNecessaryIfExistentAt σ m w is NecessaryIf m.ontic.frame (GodConcreteExists σ m) w: at every world v accessible from w, if some concrete GOD_4 exists at v then at every world accessible from v some concrete GOD_4 exists. A boxed conditional at the standpoint, not the bare actual conditional (DISAMB 7181df76) and not frame-global.
note: The Anselmian premise of the modal ontological argument in its de dicto form, on the case profile's own frame. Open; analyst formulation, attribution deferred.
